mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT mws.product_seq, mp.product_code, mp.product_name, mpc.id, mpc.process_code, mpc.process_name, mpc.process_seq FROM micro_work_submit mws LEFT JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON mws.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq LEFT JOIN micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq WHERE is_last_process = '0' and submit_type = '1' and submit_status = '1'

SELECT mp.product_seq, mp.product_code, mp.product_name, IF(mt.id IS NULL, 0, 1) AS standard FROM (SELECT mws.product_seq, GROUP_CONCAT(mws.is_last_process) AS is_last_process FROM micro_work_submit mws WHERE mws.submit_type = '1' GROUP BY mws.product_seq HAVING FIND_IN_SET('0', is_last_process) = 0) AS a LEFT JOIN micro_product mp ON a.product_seq = mp.product_seq LEFT JOIN micro_technology mt ON mt.product_seq = mp.product_seq AND mt.active_flag = '1' AND mt.tech_type='STANDARD' HAVING standard = 0

SELECT mp.product_seq, mp.product_code, mp.product_name, IF(mt.id IS NULL, 0, 1) AS standard FROM (SELECT mws.product_seq, GROUP_CONCAT(mws.is_first_process) AS is_first_process FROM micro_work_submit mws WHERE mws.submit_type = '1' GROUP BY mws.product_seq HAVING FIND_IN_SET('0', is_first_process) = 0) AS a LEFT JOIN micro_product mp ON a.product_seq = mp.product_seq LEFT JOIN micro_technology mt ON mt.product_seq = mp.product_seq AND mt.active_flag = '1' AND mt.tech_type='STANDARD' HAVING standard = 0
